verdict.rationale: Mercury advertises AI-powered automation (bill-reading, bookkeeping sync) and exposes a read-only MCP server that lets AI agents query balances, transactions, and financial context, which enables AI-driven insight generation on top of the data. However, there's no direct evidence of Mercury itself surfacing proactive AI-generated insights or suggestions inside its own product UI—the AI capabilities are mostly automation (data entry, categorization) or raw data access for external agents rather than in-product insight generation.
